nodes.label: commit object
nodes.def: Type-3 git object containing tree SHA, parent SHA(s), author, committer, timestamp, and message; forms the history DAG backbone.

nodes.label: tree entry mode
nodes.def: Octal mode in tree object: 100644 (regular file), 100755 (executable), 040000 (subtree), 120000 (symlink), 160000 (submodule).

nodes.label: tree object
nodes.def: Type-2 git object listing directory entries as (mode, name, sha1) tuples; represents a single directory snapshot at a point in time.

nodes.label: ref pointer
nodes.def: Named file under .git/refs/ containing a SHA-1; represents a branch tip, tag, or remote-tracking branch; updated atomically during operations.

nodes.label: blob object
nodes.def: Type-1 git object storing raw file contents verbatim; identified by SHA-1 of content; no filename or metadata retained.

nodes.label: sha1 hash
nodes.def: 160-bit cryptographic hash computed over object content; serves as object's unique addressable name in git's content-addressable store.

nodes.label: delta compression
nodes.def: Git's storage optimization encoding an object as a series of copy/insert commands relative to a base object; OFS_DELTA uses relative offsets; REF_DELTA uses absolute SHA-1.

nodes.label: object database
nodes.def: Directory-backed key-value store under .git/objects/; loose objects stored as zlib-deflated files keyed by SHA-1; packed objects aggregated into packfiles.

nodes.label: reachability
nodes.def: Property of an object being transitively accessible from another; defines ancestry in the commit DAG; basis for gc, merge-base, and history queries.

nodes.label: author field
nodes.def: Name and email in commit object identifying primary creator; distinct from committer who applied the patch.

nodes.label: commit graph
nodes.def: Binary file .git/objects/info/commit-graph storing commit reachability, generation numbers, and bloom filter data off the critical path.

nodes.label: mode type bits
nodes.def: The upper bits of the octal mode identifying the entry's object category: regular file, directory, symlink, or submodule; encoded in the first two octal digits.

nodes.label: object type inspection
nodes.def: git cat-file -t reveals object type; git cat-file -s shows byte size; git cat-file -p pretty-prints content; git rev-list walks commit graph.

nodes.label: commit message encoding encoding value
nodes.def: The character encoding name stored in the encoding header (UTF-8, ISO-8859-1, Windows-1252, etc.); controls byte-to-character interpretation of the message bytes.

nodes.label: commit message encoding transcoding logic
nodes.def: git's internal conversion from the stored encoding_value to the requested log_encoding_flag encoding; uses iconv-style conversion with loss handling.

nodes.label: packfile
nodes.def: Single binary file consolidating many objects via delta compression; named pack-*.pack with companion .idx index; vastly reduces repository size.

nodes.label: submodule pointer
nodes.def: Entry in a parent repository's tree object referencing a specific commit of a nested repository; stored as mode 160000 with commit SHA-1.

nodes.label: maintenance task
nodes.def: git maintenance subcommand scheduling background optimization: gc, commit-graph rebuild, incremental-repack, prefetch, prune.

nodes.label: partial clone
nodes.def: Clone with --filter omitting blob objects from transfer; missing blobs retrieved on demand via fetch-object; enables huge-repository workflows.

nodes.label: tag object
nodes.def: Type-4 git object wrapping another object with a tag name, tagger info, and message; typically used for annotated release markers.

nodes.label: author timestamp
nodes.def: Integer Unix timestamp recording when the author created the change; represents seconds since epoch (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC) in the author field.

nodes.label: commit message encoding encoding header
nodes.def: Optional header line 'encoding <encoding-name>' in a commit object's raw text; git stores whatever the user wrote verbatim.

nodes.label: content addressable store
nodes.def: Property that object identity derives solely from its content hash; same content always yields identical identifier regardless of path or history.

nodes.label: head pointer
nodes.def: Symbolic ref .git/HEAD pointing to current branch name or directly to a SHA-1 in detached mode; moves on checkout.

nodes.label: index file
nodes.def: Binary staging area at .git/index listing path->blob SHA-1 mappings plus stage numbers for unmerged entries; fast diff vs tree computation.

nodes.label: merkle tree property
nodes.def: 拜占庭容错特性: tree SHA derived from entry hashes and names; any content change ripples upward; enables tamper-evident history without full content comparison.

nodes.label: packfile index
nodes.def: Binary lookup table (.idx) enabling O(log n) SHA-1 to offset resolution within a packfile; also stores CRC-32 for integrity verification.

nodes.label: parent commit list
nodes.def: Comma-separated list of parent SHA-1s in commit object; first parent first enables linear history heuristics; octopush uses multi-parent.

nodes.label: ref backend
nodes.def: Virtual filesystem layer for ref storage; files backend for loose refs, reftable backend for high-scale; configured via extensions.refStorage.

nodes.label: reflog
nodes.def: Append-only log at .git/logs/ tracking all ref changes with old SHA, new SHA, timestamp, and actor; enables recovery from accidental resets or branch deletions.

nodes.label: unreachable object
nodes.def: Object with valid content but no reference path from any ref, reflog entry, or other reachable object; candidate for garbage collection.

nodes.label: alternates object db
nodes.def: File .git/objects/info/alternates listing paths to shared object stores; enables disk-space savings across clones.

nodes.label: author date
nodes.def: Composite of author_timestamp and author_timezone; git log --date= formats this value.

nodes.label: author name
nodes.def: String component of the author field in a commit object specifying the primary creator's display name; appears before the email in the standard <name> <email> format.

nodes.label: bundle format
nodes.def: Self-contained .git-bundle file encoding ref updates and reachable objects; enables offline transfer via removable media.

nodes.label: clean filter
nodes.def: Configured program git attributes runs on git checkout; transforms blob from object store before writing to working tree.

nodes.label: commit graph write
nodes.def: git commit-graph write traverses reachable commits and writes binary graph; --split merges small chains; --append adds commits to existing graph.

nodes.label: commit message encoding message bytes
nodes.def: Raw byte sequence forming the commit message body; decoded using encoding_value (or assumed UTF-8) to produce display characters.

nodes.label: commit message encoding transcoded message
nodes.def: The output of transcoding_logic: message_bytes decoded then re-encoded into log_encoding_flag; git log emits this to the terminal.

nodes.label: committer field
nodes.def: Name, email, timestamp, and timezone offset in commit object; records who committed (not necessarily who authored).

nodes.label: custom object db
nodes.def: Alternative backend via GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY or extensions.objectFormat; allows SHA-256, shared storage, or plugin-based stores.

nodes.label: executable file mode
nodes.def: Mode 100755; regular file with execute bits set; Git marks it this way to preserve the executable bit across platforms that handle it differently.

nodes.label: fetch head
nodes.def: Temporary .git/FETCH_HEAD file recording all branches fetched and their merge configuration for the next pull operation.

nodes.label: fsck integrity
nodes.def: git fsck traverses all reachable objects validating SHA-1 linkage, ref integrity, and accessibility; reports dangling and unreachable.

nodes.label: gc prune
nodes.def: Garbage collection process expunging unreachable objects older than prune.window; configurable via gc.prune expire and git prune.

nodes.label: graft point
nodes.def: File .git/info/grafts (or .git/shallow) overriding or truncating commit ancestry; used for repository imports with incomplete history.

nodes.label: hash object write
nodes.def: Flag hash --write causes git to store the computed object in .git/objects/ after hashing; idempotent on repeat.

nodes.label: heads namespace
nodes.def: Namespace .git/refs/heads/ containing local branch references; each file = branch name; its SHA-1 = tip commit.

nodes.label: mode bit format
nodes.def: Base-8 positional numeral system used to encode file mode; Git stores exactly 6 octal digits representing 18 bits of mode information.

nodes.label: octopus merge
nodes.def: Merge commit with more than two parents; octopus strategy combines multiple branches; refs/heads/main lists all parents in merge commit object.

nodes.label: packed refs
nodes.def: Consolidated .git/packed-refs file containing refs not in loose format; created by git pack-refs; enables faster startup on repos with many refs.

nodes.label: packfile bitmap
nodes.def: Reachability bitmap at packfile end enabling fast network transfer negotiation and clone/fetch optimization by marking all reachable objects.

nodes.label: packfile negotiation
nodes.def: Smart protocol phase where server advertises reachable refs and client computes minimum packfile of missing objects using haves/wants.

nodes.label: rebase replay
nodes.def: Replay commits as new objects onto new base; each original commit replaced; original SHA-1s abandoned; creates new history branch.

nodes.label: refspec
nodes.def: Pattern mapping source to destination ref during fetch/push: [+]<src>:<dst>; enables selective branch transfer and namespace rewriting.

nodes.label: regular file mode
nodes.def: Mode 100644; standard blob-backed file with read permission for all and write for owner; the default for non-executable files committed to Git.

nodes.label: remotes namespace
nodes.def: Namespace .git/refs/remotes/ containing remote-tracking branches; updated by fetch, not by user edits; represent server state.

nodes.label: replace ref
nodes.def: Reference under refs/replace/ mapping an object SHA to a substitute SHA; transparent to most commands; allows history rewriting without modifying history.

nodes.label: sha1 collision resistance
nodes.def: Property that finding two distinct contents with same SHA-1 requires ~2^80 operations; git relies on this for object identity.

nodes.label: sha256 migration
nodes.def: Gradual transition from SHA-1 to SHA-256 object names; support for SHA-256-only repositories since git 2.29; object format stored in config.

nodes.label: shallow clone
nodes.def: Clone with .git/shallow cut-off file listing shallow commit SHAs; prevents fetching ancestors beyond the boundary.

nodes.label: smudge filter
nodes.def: Configured program git attributes runs on git add; transforms working-tree file before storing as object; lazy loading via .gitattributes.

nodes.label: stash ref
nodes.def: Pseudo-branch at refs/stash maintained by git stash; each stash entry is a commit whose tree captures working-directory state.

nodes.label: subtree mode
nodes.def: Mode 040000; entry points to a nested tree object representing a directory; the tree entry name contains a forward slash but the slash is not stored in the entry itself.

nodes.label: symlink mode
nodes.def: Mode 120000; entry points to a blob object containing the target path as raw bytes; the blob content is the symlink destination, not the link data itself.

nodes.label: tree entry name
nodes.def: Null-terminated byte string within tree entry; may contain slash for subdirectory entries; case-sensitive on all platforms.

nodes.label: worktree pointer
nodes.def: File .git/worktrees/<name>/HEAD and GITDIR files linking a linked working tree to the main repository's object store and refs.

nodes.label: zlib compression
nodes.def: Deflate compression applied to all loose object content and packfile entries; balance of speed and ratio; configurable per object type via core.compression.

nodes.label: annotated tag signature
nodes.def: PGP signature stored within tag object body; verified by git tag -v; authenticates the tagged object SHA-1.

nodes.label: author email
nodes.def: String component of the author field in a commit object specifying the primary creator's email address; appears in angle brackets after the name in the standard <name> <email> form

nodes.label: author ident
nodes.def: Full author identity string in the form 'Name <email> timestamp timezone_offset' embedded in a commit object's author header; the canonical representation of author_field.

nodes.label: author identification
nodes.def: The combination of author_name and author_email forming the author's identity within the commit object.

nodes.label: author rfc2822
nodes.def: The RFC 2822 formatted author line: "author <name> <email> <timestamp> <timezone>" stored in commit object body.

nodes.label: author timezone
nodes.def: String timezone offset in the author field following the timestamp; formatted as +HHMM or -HHMM indicating hours and minutes east or west of UTC.

nodes.label: author vs committer
nodes.def: The semantic distinction: author created the patch content; committer applied it to the repository; git blame uses author_field as the primary attribution.

nodes.label: bisect log
nodes.def: refs/bisect/* pseudo-refs tracking midpoints and test results during git bisect; --no-checkout mode walks history without checkout.

nodes.label: blob prefetch
nodes.def: Git fetch-object or protocol v2 advertisements retrieving missing blob content on demand from partial clone; requires server support.

nodes.label: blob split threshold
nodes.def: Configuration core.bigFileThreshold beyond which git may store deltas instead of full content in packfiles.

nodes.label: bloom filter index
nodes.def: Commit-graph embedded data structure encoding paths modified per commit; powers git log --S <string> --throughput optimization.

nodes.label: branch tracking assignment
nodes.def: Remote-tracking ref establishing upstream relationship; configured via branch.<name>.remote and branch.<name>.merge; used for push.default and @{upstream}.

nodes.label: byte string content
nodes.def: The raw byte sequence forming the name; git stores no encoding assumption, no null bytes permitted within the name itself, and no guaranteed UTF-8 validity.

nodes.label: case preservation property
nodes.def: The name bytes are stored verbatim and compared byte-for-byte, making the entry case-sensitive on all operating systems including case-insensitive filesystems where the working tre

nodes.label: cherry pick delta
nodes.def: Apply single commit's diff as new commit; preserves original author; generates new SHA-1; records original SHA-1 in commit message.

nodes.label: commit date ordering
nodes.def: Revision list ordering by commit timestamp; --date-order flag; faster than topological but produces non-ancestor-first sequences.

nodes.label: commit filter
nodes.def: Revision traversal predicate (--since, --author, --grep, --S, --G) restricting which commits appear in output.

nodes.label: commit graph verify
nodes.def: git commit-graph verify reads graph and validates generation numbers, checksum, and fanout structure; reports corruption.

nodes.label: commit message encoding
nodes.def: Commit object may record encoding header; git log --encoding=UTF-8 transcodes as needed; enables non-ASCII commit messages.

nodes.label: commit message encoding display encoding
nodes.def: The terminal or output stream encoding git uses when writing the transcoded_message; git assumes UTF-8 output if terminal encoding is unset.

nodes.label: commit message encoding encoding absence
nodes.def: State when a commit object lacks an encoding header; git treats the message as UTF-8 by default per the unicode interpretation rule.

nodes.label: commit message encoding encoding fallback
nodes.def: Fallback behavior when transcoding_logic cannot map a character; typically replaces with a substitution character or skips the byte.

nodes.label: commit message encoding log encoding flag
nodes.def: git log flag --encoding=<enc> specifying the target encoding for transcoded output; overrides the stored encoding for display purposes.

nodes.label: commit message encoding original encoding
nodes.def: Alias for encoding_value; the encoding recorded at commit time distinguishing the message's original byte interpretation from the display encoding.

nodes.label: committer ident
nodes.def: Full committer identity string in form 'Name <email> timestamp timezone_offset' in the commit object; distinct from author_ident.

nodes.label: compression level
nodes.def: Integer -1 (zlib default), 0 (store), 1-9 (fast to best); set via core.compression or per-object pack-objects --compression.

nodes.label: copy instruction
nodes.def: Packfile command copying bytes from base object at offset+length; encodes file copy without recompression.

nodes.label: crc32 checksum
nodes.def: Checksum stored per object in packfile index; verified on read to detect corruption before decompression.

nodes.label: dangling blob
nodes.def: Blob object with no parent tree entry; arises from aborted rebase or staged-but-uncommitted content; harmless but obscures analysis.

nodes.label: delta island
nodes.def: Packfile grouping mechanism isolating objects reachable via specific refs; prevents cross-island delta sharing; aids monorepo incremental fetch.

nodes.label: embedded null rejection
nodes.def: The rule that a tree entry name cannot contain an internal null byte because null is the field terminator; any such byte would truncate the name prematurely.

nodes.label: empty tree sha
nodes.def: SHA-1 of the empty tree (tree with zero entries): 4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904; used as synthetic parent of root commits.

nodes.label: forward slash byte
nodes.def: The octet value 0x2F representing the ASCII forward slash character; signals subdirectory boundary in tree entry name byte sequences.

nodes.label: fsync object write
nodes.def: System call flushing object file to durable storage; controlled by core.fsyncObjectFiles; trades safety against write throughput.

nodes.label: generation number
nodes.def: Integer in commit-graph measuring topological distance from roots; enables fast ancestor queries without traversing full commit history.

nodes.label: graph tip
nodes.def: Commit referenced by a branch tip; all ancestors reachable; descendant commits unreferenced subject to gc if no other path retains them.

nodes.label: hook environment
nodes.def: Environment variables (GIT_DIR, GIT_WORK_TREE, GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH) passed to hook executables; quarantine prevents bad objects from entering repo.

nodes.label: hook trigger
nodes.def: Executable script under .git/hooks/ invoked by specific git commands (pre-commit, post-commit, pre-rebase, etc.); nonzero exit aborts operation.

nodes.label: insert instruction
nodes.def: Packfile command appending literal byte sequence to output; the raw new content not derivable from base.

nodes.label: linear history heuristic
nodes.def: Git's default rebase behavior assumes first parent path is mainline; git log --first-parent exposes linearized view; bisect follows first parent.

nodes.label: loose object
nodes.def: Individual compressed file stored at .git/objects/xx/xxxx...; fast to write but inefficient at scale; one object per file.

nodes.label: maintenance scheduler
nodes.def: Background git maintenance --scheduled running via cron or systemd timer; config thresholds in maintenance.<task>.schedule.

nodes.label: mode permission bits
nodes.def: The lower 9 bits (three octal digits) encoding Unix owner/group/other read-write-execute permissions; displayed as the last three digits of the 6-digit octal mode.

nodes.label: mode zero padding
nodes.def: The leading zero in modes like 100644 and 040000 ensures consistent 6-digit width; the zero fills the third octal digit reserved for special file type flags.

nodes.label: multi pack index
nodes.def: Compound .midx file spanning multiple packfiles; enables cross-pack object queries and accelerates repack scenarios.

nodes.label: note object
nodes.def: Blob-like object linked via refs/notes/commits/ to commits; provides annotation layer outside normal commit history.

nodes.label: null termination semantics
nodes.def: The rule that a null byte (0x00) terminates the tree entry name field, separating it from the following mode and SHA-1 blob reference within the tree entry binary structure.

nodes.label: object header
nodes.def: Four-byte prefix of every loose object: type byte + space + decimal size + null byte before payload; enables streaming deserialization.

nodes.label: octopus strategy
nodes.def: Merge strategy handling 3+ branch tips simultaneously; creates single commit with all parents; avoids intermediate pairwise merges.

nodes.label: ofs delta
nodes.def: Delta format encoding base object as relative offset within packfile; safer for streaming than REF_DELTA which names base by SHA-1.

nodes.label: ours strategy
nodes.def: Merge strategy favoring current branch content for conflicts; creates new commit with all parents but discards theirs content.

nodes.label: path separator notation
nodes.def: The forward slash character (0x2F) embedded within the name byte string signals a directory boundary; git parses no actual directory structure, only the slash as a naming conventio

nodes.label: promisor ref
nodes.def: Reference in a partial clone marking an object as promised but not yet fetched; enables placeholder usage before physical retrieval.

nodes.label: recursive strategy
nodes.def: Merge strategy recursing into trees for three-way content merge; handles rename detection and conflict presentation.

nodes.label: ref delta
nodes.def: Delta format referencing base object by its SHA-1; simpler but requires base to precede delta in packfile or be separately reachable.

nodes.label: ref transaction
nodes.def: Atomic multi-ref update mechanism; all-or-nothing semantics; used by git update-ref --transaction for safe concurrent modifications.

nodes.label: reftable format
nodes.def: Binary sorted table format for refs replacing loose files + packed-refs; compact, concurrent-writer-safe; default for repositories over 1GB.

nodes.label: remote tracking update
nodes.def: Ref update in refs/remotes/ namespace during fetch; controlled by remote.<name>.fetch config; default +refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/origin/*.

nodes.label: rev parse extended
nodes.def: Extended reference syntax: HEAD~n (n-th ancestor), HEAD^n (n-th parent in merge), HEAD@{n} (reflog entry), HEAD^{type} (dereference type).

nodes.label: revert delta
nodes.def: Generate commit whose tree undoes another commit's changes; opposite of cherry-pick; uses three-way merge to compute inverse patch.

nodes.label: revision traversal
nodes.def: An ordered walk over commits in git's object graph, visiting each revision reachable from one or more starting points (refs, commits) following parent links, in depth-first, breadt

nodes.label: root commit
nodes.def: Commit with zero parent SHAs; git mktree produces empty tree SHA; git rev-list excludes root commits with --max-parents=0 when negating.

nodes.label: signed commit
nodes.def: Commit with GPGSIG header containing cryptographic signature over commit contents; verified by git verify-commit.

nodes.label: subtree strategy
nodes.def: Merge variant treating branch tip trees as subtrees of current tree; read-tree + commit without losing either branch's subdirectory content.

nodes.label: tags namespace
nodes.def: Namespace .git/refs/tags/ containing tag references; may point directly at commits (lightweight) or at tag objects (annotated).

nodes.label: topological ordering
nodes.def: Revision list ordering guaranteeing all parents precede children; --topo-order flag; required for linearized history display.

nodes.label: transfer protocol
nodes.def: Wire format for git fetch/push; smart protocol negotiates packfile contents; dumb protocol requires static file serving of .git/objects/.

nodes.label: tree entry name case preservation
nodes.def: The property that tree_entry_name_raw_bytes preserve exact byte case from the moment of entry; git never folds case to a canonical form during storage.

nodes.label: worktree list
nodes.def: git worktree list enumerates all linked working trees sharing one object store and refs; main worktree distinguished by gitdir file location.

nodes.label: name length constraint
nodes.def: Practical limits on tree entry name bytes derived from path length limits and the 4096-byte tree object ceiling; individual names cannot contain embedded null bytes.

nodes.label: null termination
nodes.def: The terminal byte value 0x00 that marks the boundary between a tree entry name and the following field (mode space or next entry) in the binary tree object format.

nodes.label: object database loose count
nodes.def: Count of loose objects in .git/objects subdirs; high count triggers automatic gc; git count-objects reports count and size.

nodes.label: octet
nodes.def: A single 8-bit byte serving as the atomic encoding unit within a tree entry name byte string; Git stores names as raw bytes with no character encoding assumption.

nodes.label: pack depth limit
nodes.def: Maximum delta chain length before stopping; deeper chains improve compression but slow random access; default 50.

nodes.label: patch author
nodes.def: Conceptual role: the person who originally wrote the code change; represented by author_ident in the commit object.

nodes.label: path segment extraction
nodes.def: The derivation of individual directory components by splitting the name on forward slash boundaries, producing the hierarchical path representation git reconstructs.

nodes.label: platform case folding divergence
nodes.def: The mismatch where the stored tree entry name bytes are compared literally but the host filesystem may fold case on lookup, causing apparent mismatches resolved by Git's case-insen

nodes.label: reverse walk
nodes.def: Revision traversal with --reverse flag; emits commits from oldest to newest; useful for generating forward history scripts.

nodes.label: stash drop
nodes.def: Remove stash entry; objects remain reachable via reflog until reflog expiry; --index flag restores staged state from stash commit tree.

nodes.label: subdirectory segment
nodes.def: The portion of a tree entry name between forward slash bytes; corresponds to a single directory level in the repository path hierarchy.

nodes.label: subtree merge
nodes.def: Merge strategy handling repository-in-repository layout; subtrees/ subcommand maintains synthetic history linking project roots.

nodes.label: trace output
nodes.def: GIT_TRACE_PACKET, GIT_TRACE_PERFORMANCE, GIT_TRACE_SETUP, GIT_TRACE_OID logging to stderr; GIT_TRACE2 structured event output for tooling.

nodes.label: tree entry
nodes.def: A fixed-format record within a Git tree object containing an octal mode, a space separator, a null-terminated name, a space, a 20-byte SHA-1 reference, and a newline; entries are s

nodes.label: tree entry name case sensitivity
nodes.def: The property that git performs byte-exact comparison of tree entry names during lookup and merge; names differing only in case are distinct entries on all platforms including macOS

nodes.label: tree entry name dot special
nodes.def: Tree entry names equal to . or .. which git handles as special directory references in index operations; the raw bytes are stored verbatim with no transformation.

nodes.label: tree entry name extension byte
nodes.def: The period byte (0x2E) that may appear within the name to separate basename from extension; git makes no special interpretation of this byte — it is ordinary content unless it is t

nodes.label: tree entry name last slash index
nodes.def: The byte offset of the rightmost slash byte within the name; everything after this index is the filename portion, everything before (including any preceding slash) is the directory

nodes.label: tree entry name length field
nodes.def: The byte count of tree_entry_name_raw_bytes; git computes this from the offset between the space after mode and the null terminator during parsing.

nodes.label: tree entry name multi component
nodes.def: A tree_entry_name containing one or more slash bytes — represents a file at arbitrary depth; git stores the full relative path string as a single null-terminated name field.

nodes.label: tree entry name null terminator
nodes.def: The single NUL byte (0x00) that delimits the end of the tree entry name field; git parses tree objects by scanning for this byte to extract the name string from the mode-space-name

nodes.label: tree entry name raw bytes
nodes.def: The exact byte sequence stored between the space after mode and the NUL terminator; git treats these bytes as opaque — no encoding interpretation, no normalization, no validation o

nodes.label: tree entry name single component
nodes.def: A tree_entry_name with no slash byte — represents a file directly in the containing directory; the name bytes constitute the full filename without path prefix.

nodes.label: tree entry name slash byte
nodes.def: The forward-slash byte (0x2F) that may appear anywhere within tree_entry_name_raw_bytes to indicate subdirectory hierarchy; git stores the slash literally without encoding or escap

nodes.label: tree entry name utf8 byte sequence
nodes.def: A common case where tree_entry_name_raw_bytes form a valid UTF-8 encoded string representing a human-readable filename; git stores the raw bytes without validating or re-encoding t
